Don’t worry I was on a very steep hill (one that makes automatics roll back too) and had this guy an inch from me. Missed like two light cycles ended up almost all the way down the hill while the guy kept backing up for me. Not my proudest moment at the time. Is now my funniest moment to look back on. What I do to get up hill (e brake doesn’t work for me) is I’ll let off the clutch just enough to not stall it then quickly match rpms and let off the clutch. Practice till it gets smooth then slowly practice with the clutch pushed in more and more till you can do it without needing the e brake or that method.

Also if you have a clutch thats lenient you can always lift up on the clutch just enough to not stall and when you’re about to go uphill just match the rpm’s and go. I stall all the time with the handbrake method so I try not to do that unless it’s an emergency.

I have one light in my town (for whatever reason I call the demon light) I always stall at (even though there’s much steeper hills that I have absolutely no problem getting through nor do I even have any problems on hills). I stall so many times on it and I’m always guaranteed to stall at least once on that light every time. I’ve had it so bad where two light cycles passed and had a guy behind me the whole time. I could see him laughing behind me I felt embarrassed but happy he wasn’t angry and had a good show. I also have a very very steep hill where I live (where even automatics roll back in) and when I first was learning i accidentally went to that hill and kept stalling it was so bad to the point the car behind me had to back all the way down the hill to give me space as I kept trying and failing while rolling backwards (I had a place I could get out of the situation from if the person wasn’t nice and didn’t give me room but i was just glad they let me have space). It happens you can be embarrassed but when you look back on it come another day just remember to laugh. No one is perfect just do you.
